name: Chickasaw Plum
caution: Flesh only; discard cracked pits (cyanide-forming compounds). Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Harvesting
sections.body: Chickasaw plums grow in dense sun-loving thickets that turn red in June. The fruit is smaller than a Mexican plum but sweeter when fully ripe.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: Their high pectin makes them a jelly-maker's favorite: they set firm with little help.
